resource_requests_change_summary: Gateway server container requests reduced from 100m/256Mi/32Mi to 50m/128Mi/16Mi. Limits unchanged at 500m/512Mi/256Mi. The operator relaxed the requests-only constraint for this measurement.

measured_capacity_ceiling.block_reason: Pods Unschedulable: 2 Insufficient cpu, 3 Insufficient memory; cluster-autoscaler NotTriggerScaleUp: 1 max node group size reached
measured_capacity_ceiling.conclusion: The jshell node group cannot fit 100 Gateways at 50m/128Mi requests. The node group max is not adjustable from the CI identity. 45 was selected with headroom so the fixture service Pods stay schedulable.

service_pod_termination.prior_run_incident: Run 36408534388: the in-pod hypershell service container terminated at about 16 minutes, after which Gateway observation returned connection refused. Two sampled pending Gateways had Running pods at the deadline.
service_pod_termination.run_36420431666: No service container termination. The convergence loop observed all 45 Gateways to completion.

evidence_limits: The run covers the bounded live cluster capacity of the jshell node group, not the 100-Gateway product target.
Only one server Pod per Gateway is included. Consoles, databases, control-plane workers, Sandbox Pods, and platform services require more resources.
This is a scheduling and convergence check. It does not measure request throughput or set a product limit.
The 100-Gateway target remains unproved on jshell because the node group max is 5 nodes and cannot be raised from the CI identity.
